name: IELTS Reading Database
description: 100 IELTS Reading practice tests with PDF passages, answers, and metadata.

optional_files.name: passage1.md
optional_files.description: Plain-text version of passage 1 (only in test001–test004)

optional_files.name: passage2.md
optional_files.description: Plain-text version of passage 2 (only in test001–test003)

optional_files.name: passage3.md
optional_files.description: Plain-text version of passage 3 (only in test001–test003)

structure.completeness: All 100 tests have the 4 required files; no gaps.

answers_json_schema.description: Each answers.json maps test metadata and links 3 passages to their question sets.

a.description: Answer: A-D for multiple-choice, a word/phrase for note-completion, TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN for true-false-not-given.

type.description: Question type for this specific question.

multiple-choice.description: Choose the correct letter A, B, C, or D.

note-completion.description: Complete notes with a word or short phrase from the passage.

true-false-not-given.description: Decide if statements agree with the passage.

usage.reading_test: Pick a test folder → read the 3 PDF passages → answer questions → check answers.json.
usage.adding_new_test: Create a test{NNN} folder with passage1-3.pdf + answers.json following the schema above.
